title: Handle reconnect, errors and leave without leaking or resurrecting private state
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement safe connection/recovery/error/leave overlay states and client lifecycle disposal around the reviewed session port. Distinguish connecting/reconnecting/offline, invalid/full/passcode-failed lobby, host departure and permanent silent-spectator conversion; a network interruption never changes game Disconnect status. Resume hints are public conveniences, not authentication, and require authoritative membership revalidation before private view. Dispose listeners/generations/pending callbacks on leave/room or recipient switch; clear private memory/DOM and approved nonsecret hints according to the service policy. Raw provider errors/passcodes never surface or persist.
acceptance: Each named failure/recovery state has concrete safe text/action in the approved screen/modal context, never a spinner-only dead end.
Resume cannot show private identity or permit an action before authority revalidates membership.
Late snapshots/success/errors after disposal cannot restore old recipients, listeners or queued actions; cancellation is idempotent.
Backgrounding hides secret views, reconnect preserves only approved public context, and confirmed leave cannot pause/reset the whole match.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: Estados que los mocks deben cubrir; GDD-v0: Autoridad y timer online
